tools.name: channelpilotpro_list_feeds
tools.description: List the Product API feeds of a Channel Pilot Pro shop, with each feed's feed_id and unique_article_identifier. Use this first to find the feed_id.

tools.name: channelpilotpro_get_feed_status
tools.description: Get the status of a Product API feed: last_requested_offset (last upload) and last_imported_offset (last update available in Channel Pilot Pro), plus article_count.

tools.name: channelpilotpro_get_feed_data
tools.description: Read the product data a feed stored for an inclusive offset range. Use it to check what was sent. Data is kept for three days.

tools.name: channelpilotpro_upsert_products
tools.description: Create or update products in a feed. Only the fields you send change; missing products are created (operation PATCH_OR_CREATE). Repeating the same call gives the same result. Check the import with channelpilotpro_get_feed_status.

tools.name: channelpilotpro_delete_products
tools.description: Delete products from a feed (operation DELETE). Send only the identifier fields (for example sku) of each product. The products are removed from the shop data in Channel Pilot Pro.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: channelpilotpro_list_feeds, channelpilotpro_get_feed_status, channelpilotpro_get_feed_data, channelpilotpro_upsert_products · Public sink: channelpilotpro_get_feed_status, channelpilotpro_upsert_products, channelpilotpro_delete_products · Destructive: channelpilotpro_delete_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: channelpilotpro_list_feeds, channelpilotpro_get_feed_status, channelpilotpro_get_feed_data, channelpilotpro_upsert_products · Public sink: channelpilotpro_get_feed_status, channelpilotpro_upsert_products, channelpilotpro_delete_products · Destructive: channelpilotpro_delete_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
